business_summary.text: Kellton is an AI-led digital transformation and enterprise technology consulting company with global delivery capabilities across cloud, data, AI, enterprise platforms and digital product engineering.

call_points.text: No two-to-three-year projection either; management said nobody can give that guidance given AI and geopolitical change.
Order book covers nine months, giving predictable revenue near current levels but not a growth rate.
Clients are signing contracts but delaying starts, and some are pushing execution of agreed contracts, over their own cash flow worries.
Five client wins this quarter, including a Fortune India 500 conglomerate and a leading UAE enterprise group.
Moved up to select tier partner with Snowflake this quarter.
Second FCCB tranche delayed on global headwinds; management says it will happen but gave no date.
Asked how much receivables were written off, management said it did not have the FY26 number and would answer later.
Kumori was bought for ServiceNow capability, not revenue; it contributed about ₹4 Cr last quarter.
Internal KAI platform is delivering about 30% efficiency in testing, business development and analysis work.
Secured major digital transformation wins including a digital wellhead monitoring system for Oil India Limited.
Six new client wins secured in Q4 across travel tech, financial services, banking, and cyber technology.
Q4 EBITDA margin stood at 9.8% with an EBITDA of ₹30.7 crores.
Credit rating upgraded to A- reflecting financial stability.

operating_notes.text: Kellton won an enterprise-wide internal operations platform mandate from an unnamed Fortune 500 conglomerate with a major financial-services presence, using its Low-Code/No-Code PaaS framework; no value or timeline was disclosed.
Commercial launch of Structi.ai, an AI context engine processing over 10 million daily data assets across 50+ formats.

Phoenix.AI is powering a migration of more than 4 million lines of Progress ABL/OpenEdge code to Microsoft .NET Core across 12 core business modules for an unnamed US-headquartered enterprise software client.
Selected by a leading UAE enterprise group to design and implement a unified digital operating platform integrating governance, operations, and financial management.
Phoenix.AI achieved 80% to 90% code conversion automation in a 4 million lines of code migration project.
Launched Structi.ai, an enterprise AI context engine processing over 10 million daily data assets.
Kumori contributed about ₹4 Cr of revenue in the last quarter and was acquired for ServiceNow capability rather than revenue.
Order book covers nine months of predictable revenue as of the Q1FY27 call.
DSO stands at 100-plus days, driven by Fortune 100 US clients paying 90 days after invoice and slow-clearing Indian government contracts.
Won an enterprise loan integration platform contract from a leading automotive finance company.
Board approved raising funds via a rights issue of equity shares.
Board approved a rights issue of equity shares of face value Re. 1 each for up to ₹160 Cr, with terms including price and ratio still to be decided.
Secured a centralised digital engineering engagement with a leading Middle East airline.

timeline.summary: 20 Apr 2026: Kellton said it won an enterprise workflow modernisation mandate from an unnamed Fortune India 500 conglomerate, with no value or timeline disclosed.
India Ratings upgraded Kellton Tech's long-term issuer rating to IND A- with a Stable Outlook.
On 7 May 2026, Kellton Tech announced the commercial launch of Structi.ai, an AI context engine for enterprise intelligence.

18 May 2026: Kellton launched Phoenix.AI, an agentic legacy-modernisation platform it says is up to 80% faster and 50% cheaper, already running a 4-million-line migration for an unnamed US enterprise software client.
Kellton Tech announced on May 26, 2026, that it was selected by a leading UAE enterprise group to build a unified digital operating platform.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹313.89 Cr (+9.6% YoY), net profit ₹19.52 Cr (+1.7% YoY).
Kellton Tech Solutions reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,216.94 Cr and a net profit of ₹91.66 Cr.
Kellton Tech Solutions Limited’s **Krishna Chintam (Managing Director)** shared Q4-FY26 earnings call recording on June 1, 2026, via company website.
Kellton Tech reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹319 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹1,225 Cr during its earnings call on June 1, 2026.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹315.62 Cr (+6.8% YoY), net profit ₹22.32 Cr (-1.5% YoY).
Kellton Tech Solutions reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹315.62 Cr (+6.8% YoY) and net profit of ₹22.30 Cr.
On its Q1FY27 call (24 July 2026), Kellton Tech withdrew its +10% FY27 growth guidance, saying it expects to be at par or better than FY26, and flagged delayed client starts and 100-plus DSO days.
24 Aug 2026: Kellton was selected to design and build an AI-driven enterprise claims management platform for an undisclosed US healthcare company.
On September 5, 2026, Kellton Tech Solutions recommended raising up to USD 50 million via Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds and convened its AGM for September 30, 2026.
Kellton Tech was selected by a leading automotive finance company to design and build an enterprise loan integration platform.
On September 23, 2026, Kellton Tech's board approved raising funds via a rights issue of equity shares.
On September 23, 2026, Kellton Tech's board reviewed an NSE fine for delayed compliance with Regulation 31(1).
17 Oct 2026: Kellton's board approved a rights issue of equity shares up to ₹160 Cr and appointed Muskan Manucha as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer from 18 Oct 2026.
On October 23, 2026, Kellton Tech secured a centralised digital engineering engagement with a leading Middle East airline.
